feature.label: Forum
feature.description: Structured community discussions with categories, threads, replies, tags, reactions and moderation.

messages.discussionSpacesText: Browse team and community categories, find active conversations and start a focused thread where it belongs.
messages.noCategoryDescription: No description has been added yet.
messages.categoriesAdminHint: Define spaces for discussions, control ordering and restrict private categories to selected roles.
messages.categoryNameHint: Displayed in the forum overview and category header.

messages.categoryDescriptionPlaceholder: News, questions and coordination for the community.
messages.privateCategoryHint: Private categories are visible only to admins, moderators, participating users or the roles selected below.

messages.tagsAdminHint: Create reusable labels that help users filter and scan discussions.
messages.tagNameHint: Displayed on threads and in filters.

messages.tagColorHint: Choose a color that stays readable in light and dark themes.
messages.reportsAdminHint: Review reported posts and resolve items once moderation is complete.
messages.permissionsAdminHint: Assign forum capabilities to Atlas roles. Admin users keep full access automatically.

messages.forumViewReportsHint: May view reported posts in the admin area.
